datasets.grain: 当前可见人员，含离职；按personId去重
datasets.numeratorDenominator: 未定义比率；在职人数需status过滤后distinct personId
datasets.nullAndMissing: 不完整任职/字段为null+reason

datasets.grain: 当前可见在职person，左联已登记合同，保留无合同者
datasets.numeratorDenominator: coveredPersonCount / visibleActivePersonCount；覆盖多合同者仍1人
datasets.nullAndMissing: 分母0→null；待核身份/日期计unknownCoverage，不当未覆盖0

datasets.grain: 每合同登记，含草稿/作废；版本不重复成多份合同
datasets.numeratorDenominator: 签订次数按person+legalEntity+agreementCategory distinct signed/ended contractId；作废排除
datasets.nullAndMissing: endedOn优先end，空结束筛选不命中；法人/协议未知待核

datasets.grain: 每招聘需求；应聘关系candidateApplicationId计阶段
datasets.numeratorDenominator: remaining=active?max(0,headcount-hiredApplications):null；自然人数单独distinct candidatePersonId
datasets.nullAndMissing: headcount未知不得用0推算；非active remaining=null

datasets.grain: 每人每有效班次核验；不等月度期间记录
datasets.numeratorDenominator: 分钟按源班次算法；如展示覆盖率仅known coveredMinutes / known plannedMinutes并明示缺失样本
datasets.nullAndMissing: 缺打卡/冲突的uncoveredMinutes=null，不补0；不自动发布月报

datasets.grain: 每可见批次；有效工资条按paySlipId去重
datasets.numeratorDenominator: gross/deduction/net/employer为整数分分别sum；不跨币种相加
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未配置项目数值沿已批M07；未知/不可用单列，安全整数溢出拒绝

datasets.grain: 每已发布工资条；旧原值+published补差事件
datasets.numeratorDenominator: originalCents + sum(published adjustments Cents)，按adjustmentId去重；不是支付成功
datasets.nullAndMissing: 来源缺失/未知回执不填0或支付已完成

datasets.grain: 每工资条×冻结考勤引用，非员工数
datasets.numeratorDenominator: 引用分钟是各引用快照值；人数distinct personId另算，禁止引用行数作人数
datasets.nullAndMissing: 当前来源不可见/不存在为unavailable/null；原冻结值保留

datasets.grain: 每员工计划；各版本跟进单独状态计数
datasets.numeratorDenominator: pendingChanges/checkins按各recordId；可反馈只当前角色集合；不相加为总人数
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未发布结果/缺业务日期null，不填低分

datasets.grain: 仅当前有效published结果；同发布更正链1行
datasets.numeratorDenominator: 评分与评级沿已发布源版本；不得按任意updatedAt选最大
datasets.nullAndMissing: score缺失null；新draft不能替代旧published

datasets.grain: 未被另一个已published supersedes替代的review
datasets.numeratorDenominator: 潜力/绩效档位各源字段；配置人数、采集、校准、发布分别count distinct personId
datasets.nullAndMissing: 缺采集/评分null；等级不当M17准备度

datasets.grain: 每可见启用岗位；现任与后备分开
datasets.numeratorDenominator: incumbents按有效primary personId；successors distinct active personId per position；ready/one_year/two_years沿版本
datasets.nullAndMissing: 0仅当前可见范围无有效后备；未知准备度单列

datasets.grain: 每课程任务含历史复用/取消，任务不等人
datasets.numeratorDenominator: completed/enrollment分别计数；复用sourceEnrollmentId与原核验时间保留
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未核验时间/无成绩null，取消不完成

datasets.grain: 每学习计划实例
datasets.numeratorDenominator: completedRequirements / applicableRequirements；completedStages / stages分别定义，不混合权重成绩
datasets.nullAndMissing: denominator0→null；grade.not_configured/pending/provisional/final与score分列

datasets.grain: 每独立考试任务；attempt作为子记录
datasets.numeratorDenominator: attemptCount=distinct attemptId；raw earned/max与percent score分开，不用任务数当作答数
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未答score/earned/max null；次数0是真0

datasets.grain: 每独立作业任务，当前submissionId/version引用
datasets.numeratorDenominator: submissionVersion/score/reviewResult分列；passedTask比率只在明确任务分母下计算
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未评分null；未留reviewer快照明确未知，不编姓名

datasets.grain: 每培训项目×有非取消任务的人员；不是所有应参训人
datasets.numeratorDenominator: required course数按阶段定义；completed distinct courseId；missing task与pending task分开
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未完成阶段名可null仅所有阶段完成；分母0比率null

datasets.grain: 每培训项目
datasets.numeratorDenominator: participants=distinct personId(non-cancelled)；completion=completedTasks / validTasks×100，四舍五入2位；任务按enrollmentId
datasets.nullAndMissing: validTasks0→ratio null；已取消数与有效任务分开

datasets.grain: 员工×课程任务记录，重复参加用enrollmentId区别
datasets.numeratorDenominator: requiredSessions=非取消必修场次；present/absent=已verified；pending=required-present-absent
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未登记/待核验不当absent；人员与场次分母分离

datasets.grain: 每培训场次
datasets.numeratorDenominator: minutes=(endAt-startAt)/60000；cancelled effectiveMinutes=0；不当实际授课/课酬
datasets.nullAndMissing: 未关联内部讲师明确unlinked，不猜person

datasets.grain: 每讲师认证活动
datasets.numeratorDenominator: applications按applicationId可重报；people distinct personId另算；profiles/latestTrial/mandatoryProof分别计数
datasets.nullAndMissing: 交叉指标不求和为总人；未有有效证据不判通过
